void mergeSort(vector<long long>& a, vector<int>& b, int p, int r) {

vector<int> sieve(int n) {
    vector<int> a(n + 1, 1);
    a[0] = 0; a[1] = 0;
    for (int i = 2; i <= sqrt(n); i++) {
        if (a[i] == 1) {
            for (int k = 2; i * k <= n; k++) {
                a[i * k] = 0;
            }
        }
    }
    return a;
}

long long sum(int a) {
    long long su = 0;
    while (a > 0) {
        su += a % 10;
        a /= 10;
    }
    return su;
}

bool prime(int n) {
    if (n == 1) return true;
    for (int i = 2; i <= sqrt(n); i++) {
        if (n % i == 0) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool isvowel(char c) {
    return c == 'a' || c == 'e' || c == 'i' || c == 'o' || c == 'u' || c == 'y';
}

long long gcd(long long a, long long b) {
    return b == 0 ? a : gcd(b, a % b);
}

vector<int> gd(int a, int b) {
    int m = (int)gcd(a, b);
    vector<int> q;
    for (int i = 1; i * i <= m; i++) {
        if (m % i == 0) {
            q.push_back(i);
            if (i != m / i) q.push_back(m / i);
        }
    }
    return q;
}

long long sum(long long n) {

}

int divisors(int n, int m) {
    if (n - (m + m * m) >= 0) return m;
    for (int i = (int)sqrt(m); i >= 1; i--) {
        if (m % i == 0 && n - (m + m * i) >= 0) return i;
    }
    return 1;
}

bool cal(int val, int k, int t) {
    int res = val, p = 1;
    while (val / pow(k, p) > 0) {
        res += val / (int)pow(k, p);
        p++;
    }
    return res >= t;
}

int Last_Ocuu(const vector<int>& a, int n, long long v) {
    int start = 0, end = n - 1, mid, ans = -1;
    while (start <= end) {
        mid = (start + end) >> 1;
        if (a[mid] >= v) {
            ans = mid;
            end = mid - 1;
        } else {
            start = mid + 1;
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

bool Last_Ocuu(const vector<long long>& a, int n, long long v) {
    int start = 1, end = n - 1;
    while (start <= end) {
        int mid = (start + end) >> 1;
        if (a[mid] == v) {
            return true;
        } else if (a[mid] > v) {
            end = mid - 1;
        } else {
            start = mid + 1;
        }
    }

}
